verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime explicitly documents Presence ("Track and synchronize user state across clients... showing who's online") and Broadcast ("Send low-latency messages between clients" for use cases like cursor tracking, chat typing indicators) as first-party features, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration/benchmarks of presence/broadcast specifically (community evidence covers other Realtime aspects like WAL-based changes, not presence/broadcast directly).
